Revised Edition of the Laws Act
Chapter 275
Order under Section 11(3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 30th June 2004:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st July 2004, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Bills of Exchange Act (Chapter 23)
2. Business Registration Act (Chapter 32)
3. Customs Act (Chapter 70)
4. Housing and Development Act (Chapter 129)
5. Land Titles Act (Chapter 157)
6. Medical Registration Act (Chapter 174)
7. Rapid Transit Systems Act (Chapter 263A)
8. Statutory Bodies and Government Companies (Protection of Secrecy) Act (Chapter 319)
9. Statutory Corporations (Contributions to Consolidated Fund) Act (Chapter 319A)
10. Trade Unions Act (Chapter 333)
